svg.title: From 200 Screened Offers to 30 Settled Orders
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-wholesale-opportunity-cohort; chart type: funnel; title: From 200 Screened Offers to 30 Settled Orders; subtitle: One nested wholesale cohort; every later stage belongs to the prior stage.; chapter number: 6; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: Illustrative 90-day cohort of 200 distinct buying-group offers, each representing one potential order. Counts are not revenue forecasts or observed conversion rates. The funnel excludes standalone B2B payment transactions and treasury placements.; caption: Cumulative conversion is 100%, 75%, 45%, 25%, and 15%; do not multiply settled-order count by unrelated merchant GMV.; stages: label: Screened wholesale offers; value: 200 offers — 100% of the starting cohort; numeric value: 200.0; detail: Capture SKU, seller, destination warehouse, commitment price, order cap, and stated payout term. Deduplicate repeated listings before assigning an opportunity ID.; label: Verified commitments; value: 150 offers — 75% of the starting cohort; numeric value: 150.0; detail: Remove 50 offers lacking current written acceptance, verified receiving instructions, or dependable counterparty identity. The remaining 150 belong to the original 200-offer cohort.; label: Positive stressed contribution; value: 90 offers — 45% of the starting cohort; numeric value: 90.0; detail: Remove 60 commitments whose landed cost, insured shipping, payout deductions, or return exposure erase the wholesale spread. Do not rescue negative merchandise economics with unconfirmed portal rewards.; label: Funded and shipped orders; value: 50 offers — 25% of the starting cohort; numeric value: 50.0; detail: Defer 40 otherwise profitable offers because cash reserves, card availability, or counterparty exposure limits are exhausted. Ship only against documented repayment capacity and valid receiving instructions.; label: Accepted and cash settled; value: 30 orders — 15% of the starting cohort; numeric value: 30.0; detail: At the measurement cutoff, 30 shipped orders have accepted quantities and cleared ACH. The other 20 remain outstanding within the shipped cohort; keep their inventory, receivables, and liabilities visible.

text.title: From 200 Screened Offers to 30 Settled Orders
text.tspan: From 200 Screened Offers to 30 Settled Orders

circle.title: label: Screened wholesale offers; value: 200 offers — 100% of the starting cohort; numeric value: 200.0; detail: Capture SKU, seller, destination warehouse, commitment price, order cap, and stated payout term. Deduplicate repeated listings before assigning an opportunity ID.

label: Verified commitments; value: 150 offers — 75% of the starting cohort; numeric value: 150.0; detail: Remove 50 offers lacking current written acceptance, verified receiving instructions, or dependable counterparty identity. The remaining 150 belong to the original 200-offer cohort.

label: Positive stressed contribution; value: 90 offers — 45% of the starting cohort; numeric value: 90.0; detail: Remove 60 commitments whose landed cost, insured shipping, payout deductions, or return exposure erase the wholesale spread. Do not rescue negative merchandise economics with unconfirmed portal rewards.

label: Funded and shipped orders; value: 50 offers — 25% of the starting cohort; numeric value: 50.0; detail: Defer 40 otherwise profitable offers because cash reserves, card availability, or counterparty exposure limits are exhausted. Ship only against documented repayment capacity and valid receiving instructions.

label: Accepted and cash settled; value: 30 orders — 15% of the starting cohort; numeric value: 30.0; detail: At the measurement cutoff, 30 shipped orders have accepted quantities and cleared ACH. The other 20 remain outstanding within the shipped cohort; keep their inventory, receivables, and liabilities visible.

text.title: Assumptions: Illustrative 90-day cohort of 200 distinct buying-group offers, each representing one potential order. Counts are not revenue forecasts or observed conversion rates. The funnel excludes standalone B2B payment transactions and treasury placements.
text.tspan: Assumptions: Illustrative 90-day cohort of 200 distinct buying-group offers, each representing one potential order. Counts are not
